mainImage.alt: Crowd of Hezbollah supporters at a protest in Beirut, waving yellow Hezbollah flags and holding up printed images, with some people raising their fists in defiance.
mainImage.caption: Hezbollah supporters wave the party flag and hold up images during a protest against planned talks with Israel in Beirut, Lebanon, on April 11, 2026. Demonstrators urged the Lebanese government to pull out of Washington talks, calling them a 'free concession' to Israel and the US.
